hook_line: DALLAS BAPS MANDIR EXPECTS 12,000 FOR DIWALI ANNAKUT AND FIREWORKS

hook_stat.sub: Visitors expected at the Irving mandir on November 10

stats.label: Diwali and Hindu New Year celebration in Irving
Celebration runs from 3:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. on November 10
Food collected for Irving Cares in the October 2025 Dallas-area drive

diaspora_bullets: Annakut offering of hundreds of vegetarian dishes prepared by devotees
BAPS Charities will make a food donation to Irving Cares as part of the event
news_summary: The BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Irving expects roughly 12,000 visitors for its Diwali and Hindu New Year celebration on Tuesday, November 10, built around the Annakut offering of hundreds of vegetarian dishes.
payoff: The celebration closes with a fireworks show and a light-and-sound experience.
